title: Get the death certificate
official: A death should be reported to the local registrar for registration within 21 days. There is no fee if it is reported within 21 days.
suggestion: Most steps on this list need a copy of the death certificate.
contact: The birth and death registrar of your local municipality or gram panchayat
confirms: CRS FAQ: "normal period of 21 days" for reporting a death; "no fee would be charged" within it.
